observation.evaluation:
Correctness: PARTIALLY_CORRECT
Safety: CAUTION
Issues: Original image CXR2289_IM-0873-2001 is a lateral-only chest radiograph with no visible side marker; a lateral view cannot reliably distinguish right from left pleural effusion, so “right” is not independently supported over “left”; possible posterior costophrenic blunting is subtle/nonspecific and could be overcalled as effusion.
Suggestion: Confirm laterality with a frontal PA/AP radiograph or the radiology report before selecting right versus left; if only the lateral image is available, report the effusion as laterality-indeterminate.
